sources.sample_match: Stress and annealing state unspecified; transferred to the selected SiN formulation as an explicit approximation.
sources.construction: Integrate dn/dT from 300 K and add the selected material room-temperature n at 1550 nm. These are sampled fit values, not measured n(T) for this specimen.

notes: 300 K denotes nominal room-temperature data, not a separately measured exact temperature.

schema: temperature_k,wavelength_um,n,k; empty n or k means unknown
